Materialize a source's raw CSVs as a parquet cache for fast cohort selection

Source: R/duckdb_backend.R
cache_raw_parquet_duckdb.Rd

Converts each configured table's raw CSV(.gz) file(s) into a single parquet file under paths$raw_parquet_cache_dir, using the exact same typed read (.duckdb_csv_read_expr() + package schema TRY_CAST) that .ehr_select_cohort_ids_duckdb() otherwise applies to CSV on every call - so the cache is a transparent, drop-in stand-in for the CSV: same column names, same types. Original CSV column names are kept.

Usage

cache_raw_parquet_duckdb(
  src_name,
  tables = NULL,
  cohort = NULL,
  all_tables = TRUE,
  base_dir = NULL,
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  keep = FALSE,
  validate_columns = TRUE,
  memory_limit = NULL,
  threads = NULL,
  temp_directory = NULL,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  cohort_selection = NULL,
  loading = NULL,
  execution = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iii").

tables

Character vector of table names to cache. Default NULL, in which case all_tables/cohort decide what gets cached (see below) - pass this explicitly to scope the cache down to just the tables your cohort_sql/setup_sql actually queries, skipping large unused tables (e.g. free-text tables) that all_tables would otherwise include.

cohort

Optional name of a bundled example cohort (see list_example_cohorts(), e.g. "sepsis3" or "scid")

  • resolves tables automatically instead of you having to name them: the tables its packaged SQL chain references (SQL cohorts) or its configured cohort_seed_tables (ICD cohorts). Ignored when tables is supplied explicitly; otherwise takes precedence over all_tables (an explicit cohort is more specific than the "cache everything" default).

all_tables

If TRUE (the default), cache every table configured for this source. Ignored whenever tables or cohort apply - pass all_tables = FALSE together with neither of those to get the old no-op ("nothing to cache") behavior instead.

base_dir

Project root directory.

raw_data_root

Optional parent storage-root override for raw source data (as in ehr_paths()).

overwrite

Re-cache tables that already have a non-empty cached parquet. Default FALSE (skip tables already cached).

keep

Keep the cache after this R session ends. Default FALSE: the cache directory is deleted automatically on session exit, so it is scratch space for this session unless you opt in to persisting it.

validate_columns

If TRUE (the default), check every raw value against its configured type before writing the cache and record conversion-failure counts (values that fail TRY_CAST become a silent NULL otherwise, with no way to later tell "genuinely blank" from "failed to parse" - the original raw text is gone once cached). Writes a per-column report to {cache_dir}/_conversion_report.csv and warns if any column had failures. Costs a second full scan per table (validate, then convert-and-write) - set FALSE to skip it and cache at the old, unvalidated speed.

memory_limit, threads, temp_directory

Optional DuckDB resource settings for large sources, as in import_cohort_general() and materialize_cohort_duckdb(). temp_directory lets DuckDB spill to disk instead of running out of memory on a large table - a scratch spill directory is always used even when this is left NULL (removed once the function returns), since the underlying connection is :memory: and otherwise has nowhere to spill at all; pass this explicitly (e.g. temp_directory = "/scratch") only to point spilling at a specific disk (more free space, faster I/O) instead of the default scratch location.

show_progress

Print per-table progress messages.

cohort_selection

Optional overrides from cohort_selection_options() or a named list.

loading

Optional overrides from loading_options() or a named list.

execution

Optional overrides from execution_options() or a named list.

Value

Invisibly, the cache directory path, or NULL if tables was NULL, cohort was NULL, and all_tables was FALSE (nothing to do).

Details

The cache is written inside the project, under <base_dir>/data/raw_parquet_cache/<src_name> (set paths.raw_parquet_cache_root in the project config to move it), never into the raw source directory, which is treated as read-only.

Run this once per source (or after a source is re-downloaded); every subsequent select_cohort_ids_duckdb() / import_cohort_general() call against tables with a cache automatically reads parquet instead of re-parsing CSV (see use_parquet_cache on .ehr_select_cohort_ids_duckdb()).

By default (keep = FALSE) the cache is scratch space: it is removed automatically when the R session ends, so repeated selection calls within one session/script are fast without leaving parquet files behind afterward. Pass keep = TRUE to have it persist across sessions - to remove a kept cache later, just unlink(ehr_paths(src_name)$raw_parquet_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE).

Not run automatically by run_one_source() (the canonical pipeline entry point) - call it directly beforehand, or request the "cache_raw_parquet" stage via run_one_source(stages = ...).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cache_raw_parquet_duckdb("mimic_iv_demo", tables = c("labevents", "chartevents"))
} # }
